verdict.rationale: Neon documents an "Instant restore" capability for branches. Its MCP surface lists create/reset/restore branch tools plus "Finalize branch restore from snapshot", and the docs describe restores that keep the connection string via `finalize_restore: true` and snapshot restores that move between versions instantly. A production user independently confirms they "periodically reset the branch to its parent," so neither operation needs a dump. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation in the pack of the reset-from-parent mechanics, and details on the point-in-time restore window and granularity (the Instant restore page appears only as a title).
